description: This file defines a controller class 'WorthSubController' within the Goteo project's admin namespace. It manages meritocracy levels, including editing and listing functionalities, permission checks, and logging actions related to merit levels.

classes.name: WorthSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing meritocracy levels in the admin interface, providing actions to edit and list merit levels, with permission control and activity logging.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access this controller based on node role and user role.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles the edit action, delegating to the process method for 'edit'.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the list action, delegating to the process method for 'list'.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method handling the logic for editing or listing meritocracy levels, including saving changes, logging, and error handling.
